verdict.rationale: Drata documents a versioned Public API: the developer portal brands it "APIv2" and its reference lives under /openapi/reference/v2/. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a v1-to-v2 migration process, so only half the story is shown. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, sunset/notice timelines, version-migration guidance, changelog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
